_notice: SAMPLE text-only workout outlines for development. They contain no video, music or instructor likeness and are NOT professionally reviewed. Movements are generic and original. Real content needs a certified fitness professional's review (gate F1) and cleared rights (gates L1-L3) before release.

instructors.bio: A placeholder record that stands in for a real instructor. Real instructors appear only with a signed agreement covering name, image, voice and likeness.

workouts.title: Afrobeats Wake-Up
workouts.summary: A five-minute bounce-and-sway session to start the day.

blocks.title: Easy march and shoulder rolls
blocks.cue: Walk in place and roll the shoulders to raise your heart rate gently.

blocks.title: Dynamic stretches
blocks.cue: Reach overhead, side-bend, and gentle hip circles.

blocks.title: Bounce and sway
blocks.cue: Soft knees, bounce on the beat and let your shoulders sway side to side.
blocks.lowImpactAlt: Same sway standing tall with small steps; no bounce.

blocks.title: Step-tap with arm swing
blocks.cue: Step to the side, tap the other foot in, swing the arms in a relaxed arc.
blocks.lowImpactAlt: Step without the tap; keep the arm swing low.

blocks.title: Slow walk and breathing
blocks.cue: Walk in place slowly and breathe in through the nose, out through the mouth.

blocks.title: Gentle stretches
blocks.cue: Hold calf, quad and chest stretches for about 20 seconds each, without bouncing.

safety: Stop if you feel chest pain, dizziness or unusual shortness of breath, and speak to a health professional.
Clear a safe space, wear supportive footwear and keep water nearby.
You can switch to the low-impact version at any time; it is a full workout, not a lesser one.

workouts.title: Hip-Hop Bounce 10
workouts.summary: Low stance, strong arms and quick steps in a short, punchy session.

blocks.title: Easy march and shoulder rolls

blocks.title: Bounce and rock
blocks.cue: Bounce in a low stance and rock your weight forward and back.

blocks.title: Step-clap

blocks.title: Quarter-turn step
blocks.cue: Step and turn a quarter each time with a pause on the beat.

blocks.title: Slow walk and breathing

blocks.title: Gentle stretches
